description: This file defines the Special controller class for the OpenCart platform, responsible for handling the display of special product offers on a storefront. It loads necessary models, fetches special products, processes their images, prices, and other details, and renders the view or returns an empty string if no specials are found.

classes.name: Special
classes.description: Controller class for displaying special product offers on an OpenCart store.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to fetch and prepare special products data for display, returns HTML view or empty string.
